build_langfuse_logger_for_request: build a LangFuseLogger for a given request using dynamic credentials or the global logger
create_langfuse_logger_from_credentials: create a LangFuseLogger from a dictionary of credentials and cache it for reuse
get_dynamic_langfuse_logging_config: get a LangfuseLoggingConfig object from dynamic parameters or fall back to global logger values
return_global_langfuse_logger: return the global LangFuseLogger or create one from cached credentials if none is set
test_dynamic_langfuse_credentials: test whether dynamic Langfuse credentials are passed in standard callback parameters
